title: LIL MILE - Habibi
htmlContent:
LIL MILE has shared a brand new track called "Habibi," a solid, catchy hooks and confident sound. The sound in the music is one of it’s greatest elements, with a nice touch of R&B to the sound that makes you feel the grooves in your bones, that sets the perfect tone for his artistry. Once you get in the music, you get lost in the vocals that have a masterful tone that melts, as he brings the writing to life to the fullest on this record you won’t be able to get enough of.

Stream here:

https://open.spotify.com/track/5EgCvH0tXteSZsqBEIrRYF
